readerCopy.body: Power struggles become harder to contain when an old expectation of compliance stops working. When Pluto squares Lilith, the drive for control meets a refusal that is no longer willing to cooperate on the old terms. There may be far less tolerance for the unspoken rules about who gets to call the shots and who is expected to stay quiet. What has been tolerated for the sake of keeping the peace becomes harder to keep tolerating once the price is obvious. The pushback can be intense, but not every act of defiance needs to become a fight for total control.
